name.en: C-CAMP (Centre for Cellular and Molecular Platforms)

aka: Centre for Cellular and Molecular Platforms

strategy.thesis: Not-for-profit bio-incubator conceptualized in 2009 by India's Department of Biotechnology; funds, mentors and incubates life-science, biotech and agri-biotech startups and is positioned as one of India's largest life-sciences incubators.

summary.en: India's premier government-backed (DBT) bio-incubator in Bangalore, providing funding, mentoring and lab access to life-science, biotech and agri-biotech startups since 2009.

sources.title: Incubation at C-CAMP
sources.quote: C-CAMP has directly funded, mentored or incubated 450 startups and are associated with more than 2000 startups across India. Positioned as India's premier bio-incubator, K-Tech TBI at C-CAMP focuses on startups in life sciences, biotech, and agriculture.

sources.title: About Us
sources.quote: C-CAMP was conceptualized by the Department of Biotechnology, Government of India in 2009 as an enabler or catalyst of cutting-edge research and innovation in the life sciences.

strategy.thesis: Genome Valley-based life-sciences incubator offering modular wet-lab space and an analytical-services powerhouse (A-Labs) to biotech, pharma and medtech startups, backed by India's Dept of Science & Technology since 2006.

summary.en: DST-backed life sciences incubator in Hyderabad's Genome Valley with 20,000 sq ft of modular wet-lab space and an analytical facility (A-Labs) serving biotech and medtech startups.

sources.title: LSI: Accelerating Biotech Innovation in Genome Valley
sources.quote: Located in Genome Valley, Hyderabad, the IKP Life Sciences Incubator is backed by the Department of Science and Technology (DST), Government of India, since 2006. It features 20,000 sq ft of modular wet-lab space, the "A-Labs" analytical powerhouse, and a tailored suite of incubation and acceleration services.

verification_notes: Founded_year reflects the year DST backing of the Life Sciences Incubator began per official site; the broader IKP Knowledge Park entity may predate this.

strategy.thesis: CSIR-National Chemical Laboratory-hosted technology business incubator running a dedicated Bioincubator/BIG (BIRAC Biotechnology Ignition Grant) program that provides lab space, mentoring and grant administration to biological-sciences and biotech startups.

track_record.portfolio_count: 750+ science-based startups aided since inception (across materials, chemicals and biological sciences, not bio-only)

summary.en: Pune-based technology incubator hosted by CSIR-NCL since December 2006, with a Bioincubator division and BIRAC-linked BIG grant program serving biological-sciences and biotech startups.

sources.title: India's top incubator for inventive startups - Venture Center
sources.quote: Venture Center, India's largest technology incubator hosted by CSIR's National Chemical Laboratory, has aided over 750 science-based startups since its inception in December 2006.

sources.title: Bioincubator Council - Venture Center
sources.supports: bio-incubation program scope, BIRAC BIG grant administration
sources.quote: Venture Center's BioIncubator division supports biotechnology enterprises through programs including the Ignition Program, AIP-Eklavya Program, and BioEnterprise Fellowship Program, coordinating with partner institutions across India under BIRAC's BIG grant scheme.

verification_notes: Portfolio count of 750+ is across Venture Center's full technology-incubator scope (materials, chemicals, biological sciences), not bio-only.

strategy.thesis: BIRAC BioNEST-funded life-sciences incubator hosted at the University of Hyderabad, offering shared wet-lab and instrumentation space for early-stage biotech companies.

summary.en: The largest life-sciences incubator in Hyderabad, hosted at the University of Hyderabad, with a 23,000 sq ft facility supporting up to 54 biotech startups under BIRAC's BioNEST scheme.

sources.title: ASPIRE-BioNEST | Life Sciences Incubation Center
sources.quote: BioNEST is the largest life sciences incubator in Hyderabad with 23,000 sq ft facility that supports up to 54 startups. The incubation centers are equipped with state-of-the-art infrastructure and necessary instrumentation.

strategy.thesis: Atal Incubation Centre hosted at CSIR's Centre for Cellular and Molecular Biology, one of India's first 10 AICs, supporting life-science and healthcare startups in diagnostics, medical devices, oncology biopharmaceuticals, infectious disease and genomics.

track_record.portfolio_count: 80+ startups nurtured in a single year (per 2023 reporting)

summary.en: Atal Innovation Mission incubation centre at CSIR-CCMB in Hyderabad's pharma hub, offering 20,000 sq ft of lab/office space to life-science startups in diagnostics, devices, oncology biopharma, infectious disease and genomics.

sources.title: AIC-CCMB | HOME
sources.quote: AIC-CCMB is a premier life-science incubator based in the Pharma Hub of India, Hyderabad. Established in 2017, AIC-CCMB, Hyderabad, was one of India's first 10 AIC centers.

sources.title: Hyderabad: AIC-CCMB nurtured 80 startups in 1 year
sources.quote: The center offers 20,000 square feet of affordable lab and office space... For the last one year, Atal Incubation Centre-Centre for Cellular and Molecular Biology (AIC-CCMB) nurtured over 80 firms and offered various incubation, immersion, and acceleration programs.

verification_notes: AIC-CCMB official homepage could not be directly fetched (certificate error); facts corroborated via search snippets and a Newsmeter news article.

strategy.thesis: Karnataka state government (KBITS/DBT)-backed bio-incubator providing dedicated wet labs and plug-and-play office space to life-sciences, medtech, agriculture and food startups.

summary.en: Karnataka government-backed incubator (incorporated 2015, operational 2016) offering dedicated wet-lab and plug-and-play office space for life-sciences, agriculture, food and medtech startups in Bangalore.

sources.title: Bangalore Bioinnovation Centre (BBC) | Nurturing Biotech Startups
sources.quote: Bangalore Bioinnovation Centre is a premier incubation centre for Life Sciences, Agriculture, Food, and MedTech startups. The flagship Incubation Program offers state-of-the-art infrastructure with dedicated wet labs and plug-and-play office spaces.

sources.title: Bangalore Bioinnovation Centre
sources.quote: Bangalore Bioinnovation Centre (BBC) was incorporated on 10 April 2015, and it became operational since 2016. It is an initiative of Karnataka Biotechnology and Information Technology Services (KBITS)... with liberal funding support from Department of Biotechnology (DBT), Government of India.

strategy.thesis: Atal Innovation Mission-funded incubator that is the innovation arm of the Andhra Pradesh MedTech Zone (AMTZ), positioned as the only Indian incubator dedicated exclusively to health-technology/medical-device startups, co-located with AMTZ's device manufacturing cluster.

summary.en: Medtech-exclusive incubator that is the innovation arm of the Andhra Pradesh MedTech Zone in Visakhapatnam, funded by NITI Aayog's Atal Innovation Mission.

sources.title: MedTech Startup Incubators, Incubation Centre in India, MVIC
sources.quote: Medi Valley AIC: Funded by NITI Aayog under the Atal Innovation Mission, Medi Valley Atal Incubation Centre is the innovation arm of the Andhra Pradesh MedTech Zone. It is the only facility in the country dedicated to health technology and located within the medical devices manufacturing epicentre.

strategy.thesis: IISER Pune-hosted Atal Incubation Centre nurturing deep-science startups spanning biotech, healthcare and pharma alongside advanced materials, AI/ML and clean tech, leveraging IISER's research infrastructure.

summary.en: Atal Incubation Centre at IISER Pune (sanctioned 2019-20, launched 2021) supporting deep-science startups including biotech, healthcare and pharma alongside other frontier-tech verticals.

sources.title: AIC-SEED - Atal Incubation Centre, IISER Pune
sources.quote: As a technology business incubator, AIC-SEED's objective is to nurture, stimulate and encourage the growth of deep science based startups, while fostering a culture of entrepreneurship in an academic and knowledge driven research environment.

sources.title: Atal Incubation Centre inaugurated at IISER Pune
sources.quote: AIC-SEED focuses on biotech, healthcare, pharma, advanced materials, AI/ML, data science, and clean tech.

verification_notes: AIC-SEED is a multi-vertical deep-science incubator (not bio-exclusive); biotech/healthcare/pharma is one of several focus areas alongside materials and AI/ML.

strategy.thesis: India's oldest social-enterprise incubator, backing early-stage healthcare ventures (alongside agriculture, climate and gender-inclusion) serving low-income and rural markets, via grant funding, mentorship and investor linkages rather than pure equity investment.

track_record.portfolio_count: 300+ ventures incubated overall; 70% operationally profitable within 3 years of graduation

summary.en: Chennai-based social-enterprise incubator founded in 2001, providing grants (INR 15 lakh-75 lakh), mentorship and market/investor linkages to healthcare (plus agri, climate, gender-inclusion) startups serving underserved markets.

sources.title: Villgro | Making Innovative, Impactful Social Enterprises Succeed
sources.quote: Villgro is India's foremost impact-first incubator with expertise in 4 sectors – Healthcare, Agriculture, Climate Action, and Gender Inclusion.

sources.title: Villgro Innovations Foundation, Chennai
sources.supports: founding year, grant sizes, portfolio outcomes
sources.quote: Villgro Innovations Foundation (Chennai) is India's oldest social enterprise incubator, founded in 2001... Villgro provides grants of ₹15 lakh to ₹75 lakh, 100+ volunteer mentors, market linkage through its corporate partner network, and access to impact investors. Of 300+ Villgro-incubated ventures, 70% are operationally profitable within 3 years of graduation.

aka: Healthcare Technology Innovation Centre MedTech Incubator

strategy.thesis: IIT Madras Research Park-based medtech-exclusive incubator guiding entrepreneurs through Explore-Build-Market-Operate stages from prototype to commercialization, with specialized SPARSH and CAWACH programs for the health-tech sector.

summary.en: IIT Madras's Healthcare Technology Innovation Centre incubator, based at IITM Research Park in Chennai, dedicated to guiding medtech entrepreneurs from prototype through commercialization.

sources.title: Home – MedTech Incubator
sources.publisher: Healthcare Technology Innovation Centre, IIT Madras
sources.quote: Guiding entrepreneurs applying technology to create an impact in the health sector. Entrepreneurs x Technology = Impact. Explore, Build, Market, Operate.

verification_notes: Founding date and detailed program metrics not published on the site.

strategy.thesis: Ahmedabad University's incubator, BIRAC-authorised for bio-incubation, running a dedicated bioincubation centre with laboratory infrastructure for biotechnology, life-science, medical-device and diagnostics startups.

summary.en: Ahmedabad University incubator established in 2011 (in collaboration with Stanford's Center for Design Research) and authorised by BIRAC for bio-incubation, offering lab infrastructure to biotech, life-science, medtech and diagnostics startups.

sources.title: VentureStudio
sources.supports: founding year, BIRAC bio-incubation authorization, sector scope
sources.quote: VentureStudio, established in 2011 in collaboration with Stanford University's Center for Design Research, is authorised for bio-incubation by the Biotechnology Industry Research Assistance Council (BIRAC). It provides a specialized bioincubation centre supporting startups in biotechnology, life sciences, medical devices, and diagnostics with cutting-edge laboratory infrastructure and technical expertise.

verification_notes: Entity name 'VentureStudio' is unrelated to the taxonomy's 'venture-studio' (Flagship-style company-creation) type; classified here as 'incubator' since it is a BIRAC-authorised bio-incubation centre, not a company-creation studio.

strategy.thesis: BIRAC BioNEST-funded bio-incubator managed by the Regional Centre for Biotechnology in Faridabad (Delhi NCR), offering shared lab benches, independent cubicles and research infrastructure geared toward vaccine and therapeutics startups.

summary.en: BIRAC BioNEST bio-incubator run by the Regional Centre for Biotechnology in Faridabad (Delhi NCR), providing shared lab benches and independent cubicles for vaccine and therapeutics startups.

sources.title: Healthcare Start-ups | Biotech Startups | Incubation Space in Delhi NCR
sources.supports: existence, funding source, facility type, focus
sources.quote: The BSC BioNEST Bio-Incubator (BBB) is funded by BIRAC under the BioNEST scheme and is managed by the Regional Centre for Biotechnology (RCB). BBB provides cutting-edge infrastructure ideal for developing vaccines and therapeutics, and offers incubation services for individual & startup companies with shared lab benches as well as independent cubicles.

strategy.thesis: Gujarat state government biotech research center providing subsidized shared laboratory infrastructure (genomics, proteomics, bio-banking) to startups, students and industry — functioning as shared lab space for the state's life-science entrepreneurs.

summary.en: Gandhinagar-based Gujarat government biotech research center (est. 2017) offering genomics, proteomics and bio-banking lab facilities to startups at a 50% usage subsidy.

sources.title: Home - Gujarat Biotechnology Research Centre
sources.publisher: Department of Science & Technology, Government of Gujarat
sources.quote: Gujarat Biotechnology Research Centre is based in Gandhinagar... constituted by the Department of Science & Technology on 11th August, 2017 to undertake biotechnology research in the state priority areas. GBRC is equipped with high end infrastructure in Genomics, Proteomics, Bio-banking and Bioprospecting. Students and Start-ups are provided 50% subsidy on Shared lab usage.

verification_notes: GBRC is primarily a state research center that also serves as a shared-lab facility for startups; included for its explicit startup lab-space subsidy program rather than as a classic accelerator/incubator with cohorts.
